name: Optimised FSAE-style front corner (front-left)
description: Phase 6: front anti-roll bar added (6.5 N m/deg), static camber set to -1.6 deg so the outside tyre is at about -1 deg at 1.5 g, and the upper ball joint lowered 2 mm to keep it inside the rim at the new camber. Earlier: output of `suspkin optimize data/baseline_fsae_front.json data/optimize_front.json`, then hand-tuned in Phase 4: lower-arm front pivot 5 mm down and rear pivot 5 mm up (anti-dive -1% -> 22%), outer tie-rod end 20 mm outboard (Ackermann -16% -> +17%), and the rack moved 0.6 mm out / 0.7 mm down to cancel the extra bump steer. Inside the 10 inch rim envelope.
coordinate_system: SAE/ISO vehicle axes: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Origin on the ground plane, on the car centerline, at the front axle line.

packaging._note: 10 inch rim envelope, checked in the wheel's own frame (see solver/suspkin/packaging.py)

vehicle._note: Whole-car numbers for anti-dive / anti-squat, Ackermann and roll stiffness (see solver/suspkin/sideview.py). spring_rate_n_per_mm is one corner's spring (35 N/mm is about 200 lb/in). mass_kg is car + driver; the rear_* numbers are placeholders until the rear corner is designed. Made-up FSAE-sized values.

point_descriptions.RTO: Tie rod outer end (steering arm on the upright)
point_descriptions.PRO: Pushrod outer end (bracket on the lower A-arm)
point_descriptions.RKP: Rocker pivot (on its rotation axis, on the chassis)

rocker._note: Pushrod and rocker (bellcrank). The rocker spins about 'axis' through RKP. See solver/suspkin/rocker.py.

arb._note: Front anti-roll bar (U-bar). A drop link runs from ARL on the rocker down to the end of the bar's arm (ARA); the arm joins the bar at ARP and the bar runs straight across the car (Y axis). See solver/suspkin/arb.py. Rate chosen in Phase 6 for ~51% front lateral load transfer.
